clue.text: Competition to get church into expensive contract

clue.text: Smoke in fact at intervals seen in dish

clue.text: Exclaimed, being rejected having dropped round

clue.text: An obsession with single number on record?

The page boy in the pantomime Cinderella, and a name for any uniformed page

clue.text: Rip-off maintained by boss? I see what you mean
